definitions.explanation: A member of the human species; humanity in general.
An individual's personality, nature, or character.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}の{体|からだ}は{水|みず}でできている。
examples.english: The human body is made of water.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}は{社会的|しゃかいてき}な{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい}は{難|むずか}しい。
examples.notes: {人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい} = human relationships

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}は{一人|ひとり}では{生|い}きていけない。
{地球|ちきゅう}には{人間|にんげん}のほかにも{多|おお}くの{生|い}き{物|もの}がいる。
examples.english: Besides humans, there are many other living creatures on Earth.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{立派|りっぱ}な{人間|にんげん}だ。
examples.english: He is a fine person (of good character).

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}として{成長|せいちょう}したい。
examples.english: I want to grow as a person.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{人間|にんげん}ができている。
examples.notes: {人間|にんげん}ができている = to be a person of good character

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{能力|のうりょく}だけでなく、{人間|にんげん}としての{魅力|みりょく}も{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: Not only work ability, but personal charm is also important.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人間|にんげん}{味|み}のある{先生|せんせい}で、{学生|がくせい}からとても{慕|した}われている。
examples.english: He's a teacher with a warm human touch, and is greatly admired by his students.
examples.notes: {人間|にんげん}{味|み} = human warmth, human touch

notes:
USAGE: {人間|にんげん} can refer to humans as a species or to a person's character/nature. It's more philosophical/formal than {人|ひと}.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい} (human relationships, interpersonal relations)
・{人間|にんげん}{性|せい} (human nature, humanity)
・{人間|にんげん}{的|てき} (human, humane)
・{人間|にんげん}{味|み} (human touch, warmth)
・{人間|にんげん}{不信|ふしん} (distrust of people)
・{人間|にんげん}{国宝|こくほう} (Living National Treasure)

CONTRAST:
・{人間|にんげん} - human (philosophical, species-level)
・{人|ひと} - person (everyday, individual)
・{人類|じんるい} - mankind, humanity (collective)
